# survival dependency provenance

These sources were supplied by the user as a modern Fortran translation of the R `survival` package.
The referenced upstream release is `survival` 3.8-9 (published 2026-07-08), by Terry M. Therneau and contributors.
Upstream license: LGPL (>= 2), represented here as SPDX `LGPL-2.0-or-later`.
The Fortran source files already carry `SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.0-or-later` headers.
